pages.title: Infection Scanner
pages.text: A scanner block. It scans the user standing on it for the Immortuos Calyx parasite. If the user is infected, a negative tone will play and this scanner will produce a redstone signal. If not, a positive tone will play and the redstone signal will not be produced.

pages.title: Health Scanner
pages.text: A portable health scanner, gives information on the infection rate of individuals where applicable, as well as other health based stats.
